text: 乔木封面是面向 DSH 网页客户端的封面设计插件。它在 DSH 中注册封面视图和 .qcover 文件类型，并提供新建、打开、从笔记创建封面等命令。用户可在画布中编辑设计，通过 AI 辅助排版或生成图像，管理本地图片与 Unsplash 素材，并将作品导出为图片或插入来源笔记。适合需要制作社交平台封面、整理设计稿并从笔记发布配图的用户。使用 AI 模型需自行配置相应服务；搜索 Unsplash 图片需配置 Access Key 或代理。

Qiaomu Cover Design adds a cover editor to DSH. Create projects or start from notes, edit on a canvas, then export images or insert them into notes. Its gallery handles local, uploaded and generated images. AI and Unsplash features need user configured services.
想在 DSH 里做一张社交平台封面。
我想把笔记内容整理成封面设计。
需要一个能编辑图层和文字并导出图片的画布。
能不能用 AI 帮我排版或生成封面配图？
I need to turn a note into an editable cover image.
Can I manage generated and local images while designing a cover?
乔木封面的功能「画布与工程编辑」：打开或新建封面工程，在画布中编辑图形与文字，并以 .qcover 文件类型保存和重开。
乔木封面的功能「从笔记创建与写回」：可从 Markdown 笔记或选中文本发起封面制作；导出时可将图片插入来源笔记或写入 cover 属性。
乔木封面的功能「导出封面图片」：将当前画布导出为 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP，可调整尺寸和质量，并选择工作区、笔记目录或系统目录。
乔木封面的功能「图片图库与生成任务」：图库汇集上传、本机文件夹和生成的图片，可搜索、筛选并选取素材；图像任务有独立结果入口。
乔木封面使用 Unsplash 搜索时，需要用户配置 Access Key 或代理；搜索请求会发送到 Unsplash 或所配代理。
我想从模板开始做图，再导出成适合社交媒体的图片。
I want to design a cover from a template and export it for social media.

qiaomu-cover-design-dsh README · 乔木封面 · DeepSeek Harness：> v0.1.3：DeepSeek Harness **0.2.2-rc.1** 兼容更新。[本次验证范围](docs/DSH-0.2.2-RC1.md)。

[English](README.en.md)

把想法、笔记和图片做成封面。在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接使用乔木封面原版画布、图层、字体、模板、AI 设计面板和导出窗口。

qiaomu-cover-design-dsh README · 功能：- 原版 Fabric 画布：文字、形状、图片、自由画笔、图层、组合、对齐、网格、安全区、撤销与重做。
- 46 个模板、12 种发布尺寸，保留 A/B 变体、风格系列、排版与配色工具。
- 34 款默认字体自动下载并校验；74 款字体目录、可选字体包、本地字体导入、图标与素材。
- 多个 `.qcover` 工程与 Markdown 来源笔记，自动保存、冲突保护、重新打开时恢复标签页。
- 原版 AI 设计对话、局部修改、历史、分支画布与多服务模型设置；图像任务切换面板后继续运行，结果保留在图库。
- 上传图片、本机目录、生成结果和 Unsplash 图库；搜索、筛选、重命名和删除。
- PNG、JPG、WebP，1/2/3 倍、质量与体积控制、透明选区；可导出到工作区、来源笔记目录或系统目录，插入笔记并写入 `cover` 属性。
- Home 最近工程与新建入口、原快捷键、中文/英文界面和深浅主题。

qiaomu-cover-design-dsh README · 安装与开始：要求 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-rc.1`、Node.js 24.9 或更新。

从 [Releases](https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-cover-design-dsh/releases) 下载 tgz 和 SHA256SUMS，校验后在插件管理安装，或运行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/qiaomu-cover-design-dsh-0.1.3.tgz
```

侧栏打开「乔木封面」，顶部「更多 → 新建封面」，填写标题并选择原版模板。选中文字在右侧调整字体、颜色与排版，点击「导出」保存。窄窗口下用左上角按钮收起 AI 面板即可查看画布。

qiaomu-cover-design-dsh README · 原版数据迁移：「更多」提供工程/笔记/附件导入、工作区文件夹导入和原 `data.json` 设置导入。目录导入保留相对结构，重名文件另存编号；原文件不修改。请一并导入工程引用的来源笔记、图片与字体。单文件上限 64 MB。

默认工作区在 `$DSH_HOME/qiaomu/qiaomu-cover-design-dsh/workspace`（未设置 DSH_HOME 时使用 `~/.dsh`）。`notesDir` 可指定明确选择的工作区绝对路径，`dataDir` 指定状态目录。字体、图库和任务缓存放在工作区的 `QiaomuCoverData`；删除工程进入 `.trash`。

qiaomu-cover-design-dsh README · 原版数据迁移：API 密钥写入 macOS Keychain、Windows DPAPI 或 Linux Secret Service，状态 JSON 只保留凭据引用。Linux 需要 `secret-tool` 和可用的 Secret Service。原宿主账号授权需重新连接。设置「模型与服务」保留原版多服务接入；DeepSeek 使用 `deepseek-flash`。使用 Codex 连接需要安装其 CLI。AI 服务可能收费，由你配置并触发。

桌面端选择系统目录使用 Harness 目录选择器；浏览器端填写运行 Harness 的电脑上的绝对路径。系统字体读取与剪贴板依赖宿主授权。Unsplash 需要自己的接入配置和相应图片许可。

qiaomu-cover-design-dsh README · 验证与开发：152 项测试覆盖原业务、模板排版、生成任务、OAuth/Codex 协议、文件冲突、凭据、路径与网络边界。在独立 Harness profile 实测编辑、撤销、笔记写回、三种图片格式、后台生成、本地图库、字体、深浅色和 720 像素窗口。

AI 生成/排版与登录协议使用本地 fixture 验证，没有调用付费模型或登录真实服务；Windows/Linux 凭据及手机触控未做实机验证。详见 [迁移与验收对照](docs/ADAPTATION.md)。

```sh
npm ci
npm run check
npm pack
```

测试模板排版需要 `canvas` 原生依赖；CI 会确认该依赖可用，不以跳过测试替代通过。

qiaomu-cover-design-dsh README · 验证与开发：MIT。原版 [qiaomu-cover-design](https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-cover-design) 冻结基线 `c56bb742eecc0c9f6bbd419c598060aa99d5410f`。原 CSS 保持一致，宿主容器、文件、网络、凭据和生命周期单独适配。依赖及资源许可见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

Harness 0.2.2-rc.1 适配与实测边界见 [兼容验证记录](docs/DSH-0.2.2-RC1.md)。

section: Qiaomu Cover Design for DeepSeek Harness

text:
qiaomu-cover-design-dsh README · Features：- Original Fabric editor: text, shapes, images, freehand drawing, layers, groups, alignment, guides, safe zones and undo/redo.
- 46 templates and 12 platform sizes; A/B variants, saved style series and layout/color tools.
- 34 default fonts downloaded with integrity checks, a 74-font catalog, optional packs and local font import.
- Multiple `.qcover` projects and Markdown source notes, autosave, conflict protection and restored tabs.
- Original AI conversations, local edits, history and branched canvases. Image generation continues when another Harness panel is open; results remain in the gallery.
- Uploaded/generated images, local folders and Unsplash, with search, filters, rename and delete.
- PNG/JPEG/WebP at 1×/2×/3×, quality/size controls and transparent selection export. Save to workspace, source-note or system folders, embed in notes and update the `cover` property.
- Qiaomu Home integration, keyboard shortcuts, Chinese/English and light/dark themes.

qiaomu-cover-design-dsh README · Install：Requires Harness `0.2.2-rc.1` and Node.js 24.9+.
Download the tgz and SHA256SUMS from [Releases](https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-cover-design-dsh/releases), verify the checksum and install through Plugin Manager or:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/qiaomu-cover-design-dsh-0.1.3.tgz
```

qiaomu-cover-design-dsh README · Install：Open Qiaomu Cover Design in the sidebar. Choose More → New cover, enter a title and select a template. Edit objects in the inspector, then export. Collapse the left panel to see the canvas on narrow windows.

qiaomu-cover-design-dsh README · Migration and storage：The More menu imports projects/notes/assets, whole workspace folders and original `data.json` settings. Folder imports preserve relative paths; duplicate names get numbered. Original files remain untouched. Include source notes, fonts and referenced assets. Files are limited to 64 MB.

qiaomu-cover-design-dsh README · Migration and storage：Default workspace: `$DSH_HOME/qiaomu/qiaomu-cover-design-dsh/workspace`, with `~/.dsh` as the default DSH_HOME. Configure absolute `notesDir` and `dataDir` paths to select a workspace or state directory. Fonts, gallery and jobs live under `QiaomuCoverData`; removed project files go to `.trash`.

qiaomu-cover-design-dsh README · Migration and storage：API keys use macOS Keychain, Windows DPAPI or Linux Secret Service rather than plaintext state. Linux needs `secret-tool` and an active Secret Service. Reconnect account authorization in the new host. The original Models & Services screen supports existing providers; DeepSeek uses `deepseek-flash`. Codex connections need its CLI. Configured AI services may charge for requests you initiate.

qiaomu-cover-design-dsh README · Migration and storage：Desktop clients use Harness's folder chooser. Browser clients enter an absolute path on the Harness host. Local system fonts and clipboard depend on host permissions. Unsplash requires your own configuration and applicable photo licensing.

qiaomu-cover-design-dsh README · Validation：152 tests cover original business logic, real canvas template layout, image jobs, OAuth/Codex protocols, storage conflicts, credentials and network/path boundaries. Independent Harness QA exercises editing, undo, note writeback, three image formats, background generation, local gallery, fonts, light/dark and 720px layout.

qiaomu-cover-design-dsh README · Validation：AI and account protocols were tested with local fixtures, without paid model calls or real account sign-in. Windows/Linux credential storage and physical mobile touch are not device-tested. See the [migration record](docs/ADAPTATION.md).

```sh
npm ci
npm run check
npm pack
```

Template layout tests require the native `canvas` dependency; CI checks that it is available.

qiaomu-cover-design-dsh README · Validation：MIT. Adapted from [Qiaomu Cover Design](https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-cover-design), commit `c56bb742eecc0c9f6bbd419c598060aa99d5410f`. Original CSS is retained, with separate Harness host boundaries. See [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

See the [Harness 0.2.2-rc.1 compatibility record](docs/DSH-0.2.2-RC1.md) for tested paths and limitations.
